mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the federal funds rate above 5% over two consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that raises discount rates and depresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 5.0% and remains above for two months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the mechanism fails when inflation exceeds 4% simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) of more than 2% coincident with a rise in the housing starts index (HOUST) signals weakening aggregate demand but a nascent housing recovery, which historically precedes a muted S&P 500 rally over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY change < -2% AND HOUST > previous 6-month average
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or the mechanism does not activate during a confirmed recession.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase of at least 0.4 percentage points in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) for three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which historically precede negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises by >0.4pp for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes, or the mechanism fails when wage growth exceeds 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average by more than 1.5% for four consecutive months signals a broad-based supply shock, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 12-month MA by >1.5% for four consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the mechanism does not activate during a confirmed global supply disruption.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous monthly decline of at least 0.3% in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) and a cut in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a coordinated monetary easing response to deflationary pressure, which historically supports positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL falls by >0.3% AND FEDFUNDS cuts in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the mechanism fails when unemployment rises above 6%.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly increase of at least 1% in real personal income (PAYEMS) for four consecutive months signals strengthening household balance sheets, which historically precedes positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of cycle phase.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of triggered episodes over any 10-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly acceleration in payroll employment (PAYEMS) of at least 0.5% coincident with a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by at least 0.2 percentage points signals a tight labor market, which typically precedes positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 0.5% AND UNRATE < previous month by >0.2pp
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of triggered episodes, or the mechanism fails when inflation exceeds 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline of more than 2% in real retail sales (RSAFS) for three consecutive months signals a sharp contraction in consumer spending, which historically precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days unless offset by a concurrent housing boom.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls by >2% for three consecutive months
regime_hint: retail demand collapse without housing offset
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the mechanism fails when HOUST rises by more than 10% in the same three-month window.
